title: jammy croatian date-night tart
description: a sweet, flaky, ovo-vegetarian-friendly dessert, perfect for a romantic evening in, featuring a dark, soft brown sugar filling.
instructions: mix flour and butter in a bowl until crumbly.
add cold water and mix until dough forms.
roll out dough and place in tart pan.
bake crust for 18 minutes, or until golden brown.
while crust bakes, mix brown sugar, eggs, and milk in a separate bowl.
add spices and mix until combined.
when crust is done, pour sugar mixture into crust and continue baking for 25 minutes, or until filling is set.
